credentials.description: OAuth token from your Yango Delivery account (Integration tab, Get token); changing the account password invalidates it

example_prompt: Estimate the cost of a Yango Delivery courier between two addresses in Abidjan before creating a claim.

coordinates.description: Coordinates of points in the form of an array of two real numbers: longitude and latitude — exactly in that order. ``` [ 0.1, 0.1 ] ```

fullname.description: Full address with an indication of the city, street, and house number. You don't need to specify the flat, the entrance number, or the floor.

id.description: Numeric point id (int64). The parameter is mandatory if there are multiple delivery points in the order

route_points.description: Route points. Sorted in order of visits A-B1....BN

dropoff_point.description: ID of the point (int64) to deliver the item to. It can be any number. Must match the route_points[].id value of the destination point. The parameter is mandatory if there are multiple delivery points in the order.

pickup_point.description: ID of the point (int64) to pick up the item from. It can be any number. Must match the route_points[].id value of the dispatch point. The parameter is mandatory if there are multiple delivery points in the order.

size.description: Unit dimensions in meters. The actual values should be added to the fields. If the dimensions aren't added, the order is placed, taking into account the maximum dimensions allowed for the selected rate. If the actual characteristics of the unit exceed the allowed dimensions, the courier has the right to refuse to fulfill the order on site. In this case, the minimum fee will be withheld. Courier: up to 0.80 m × 0.50 m × 0.50 м Express: up to 1.00 m × 0.60 m × 0.50 m Cargo: - Small body: up to 1.70 m × 0.96 m × 0.90 m - Medium body: up to 2.60 m × 1.30 m × 1.50 m - Large body: up to 3.80 m × 1.80 m × 1.80 m

gotchas: Authenticate with 'Authorization: Bearer <OAuth token>'. The token comes from your Yango Delivery account (log in with the credentials your Yango Delivery manager gives you, Integration tab, Get token). It remains valid indefinitely, but changing the account password invalidates it; an invalid token answers 401 unauthorized.
This is a first estimate, without creating a claim. The price you confirm is the offer computed after create_delivery_claim (pricing.offer in get_delivery_claim).
Coordinates are [longitude, latitude] — in that order. The error guide links unknown_zone to coordinates sent in the wrong order.

requirements.taxi_class is courier, express or cargo. The reference lists cargo_type van, lcv_m, lcv_l and lcv_xl; the FAQ gives weight caps only for courier (10 kg), express (20 kg) and van / lcv_m / lcv_l (300 / 700 / 1400 kg). Loaders: the reference says 0, 1 or 2, the FAQ 1 or 2.
Send real item dimensions: without them the rate's maximum dimensions are assumed, and a courier can refuse an item that exceeds them on site — the minimum fee is still withheld.
Accept-Language is a required header on this endpoint (e.g. en); this example sends en.

delivery.yango.com lists Côte d'Ivoire, Ghana, Senegal and Zambia under Africa. The Côte d'Ivoire and Senegal pages mention API integrations; the Ghana and Zambia pages say 'integrations' without naming the API. Every example in this reference uses UAE data (AED prices, +971 phone numbers): confirm with your Yango Delivery manager that API access is open in your country.

No test environment is documented: requests go to the production host, and confirming a claim starts the search for a courier. The error guide mentions test accounts (required_tariffs_disabled_for_user: 'Test account has expired or the specified rate is disabled') — ask your manager for one before testing.

Errors return { code, message }: branch on code. Documented on this endpoint: 400 bad_request, address_not_found; 409 errors.suitable_offer_not_found, estimating.cant_construct_route, estimating.cargocorp_payment_failure, estimating.claim.no_zone_id, estimating.limited_by_claims_creation_overflow, estimating.no_pickup_point, estimating.payment_method_cant_order, estimating.payment_method_zone_unavailable, estimating.permitted_tariffs_not_enough, estimating.requirement_unavailable, estimating.route_too_long, estimating.tariff.no_categories, estimating.tariff.no_categories_in_zone, estimating.tariff.no_sdd_tariff, estimating.tariff.no_tariff_plan, estimating.too_large_linear_size, estimating.too_many_loaders, estimating.warning.too_heavy_item, estimating.warning.too_large_item; 429 too_many_requests. The error guide adds 401 unauthorized (invalid token) and 500 (try again or change the request).
open_questions: No test environment is documented: the API reference gives only the service URL b2b.delivery.yango.tech, and confirming a claim starts a real courier search. Ask your Yango Delivery manager for a test account.
